title: two unrelated syntax errors in one file
note: Only ONE error is reported, deliberately: the missing semicolon after `attribute x : Real` is accepted by the parser's leniency (see L2-missing-semicolon, where the resulting model is verified identical to the corrected file's), so the unknown keyword `blok` is the only real fault. OBSERVATION, pre-existing: error recovery re-homes the declarations after the fault to the ROOT namespace — note `C` among the roots — rather than keeping them inside `package P`. The elements survive, but their containment does not.
